judge.note: Local judge (ADR-0019) -- zero-cost, reproducible without a live key. Replaces llama-3.3-70b-versatile (Groq) used for the prior n=60 baseline. Means below are NOT comparable to that prior baseline: both the gold set (train-contamination removed, ADR-0018) and the judge model changed simultaneously -- this is a new baseline, not a corrected old one.

threshold.method: One-directional per-repo mean regression check: fires only if new_mean < baseline_mean - band. Improvements above the band never trip it.

measured_jitter.source: Two independent full local-judge re-recordings (attempt1 n=65, attempt2 n=57 before an unrelated Groq synthesis TPD stop), compared on 57 issues common to both.
measured_jitter.note: Empirically measured, not guessed -- see ADR-0019.

threshold.vscode_note: microsoft/vscode's band (0.45) is wider than kubernetes/kubernetes's (0.22) because n=11 makes its mean statistically less stable -- this is the honest signal of the vscode data-ceiling finding (ADR-0017), not a fudged tolerance. Its gate is genuinely coarser.
threshold.retention_note: GG decision, 2026-08-10: these bands are carried forward UNCHANGED from ADR-0019's original two-recording jitter study, not re-derived against this baseline's own recording. A real re-derivation needs a second independent full recording compared on common issues (the ADR-0019 methodology) -- using the spread across DIFFERENT issues within this single recording instead would conflate genuine cross-issue signal variance with measurement jitter, overestimating noise and silently loosening the gate (a false-negative risk). No compatible second recording exists under the current prompt/model version, and producing one costs a full Groq TPD-budget recording (~215K tokens, most of a day's quota) for a benefit that isn't established: the judge itself (qwen3:8b, same temperature, same 6 dimensions) is unchanged from the ADR-0019 study -- what changed between then and now is the inputs being judged (retrieval corpus, resolution model, classifier), not the judge's own noise characteristics. Carrying forward a properly-derived band from an unchanged judge is more defensible than either spending most of a day's quota to re-derive it on spec or fabricating one from within-recording spread. Re-derive opportunistically if a second full recording happens for another reason (e.g. a future model/prompt cutover requiring one anyway) -- not proactively for this alone.

synthesis_quality_floor.note: ADR-0028 Phase B3: the mean-band gate above is a REGRESSION detector, not a quality floor -- it cannot catch fabrication (the judge never sees classifier_top3/retrieved_numbers) and averages away a correctness-critical floor-fail rate. per_repo[repo].fabrication_rate and .floor_fail_rate are additive first-class metrics, computed with zero new LLM calls (reused from plan.grounding_status and the judge dimension scores already produced).

fabrication_rate.definition: fraction of plans where plan.grounding_status.all_grounded is False (predicted_component not in classifier_top3, or any cited similar-issue number not in the retrieved set for that request).
fabrication_rate.gate: BLOCKING (promoted 2026-08-10): eval/test_quality_regression.py asserts fabrication_rate == 0 per repo. Was informational-only under eval-gate.yml's continue-on-error:true (GG decision, 2026-07-11) pending a real-world observation window; that window is over -- measured 0/64 on the current baseline, and the observation period surfaced three separate real bugs masked by the same continue-on-error (model-manifest drift, a broken _load_classifier import, a stale grounding-ratchet hash), so the case for keeping any check in that job non-blocking is gone.

floor_fail_rate.definition: fraction of plans where component_match==0 OR similar_issues_relevance==0 (the judge's own worst-band signal).
floor_fail_rate.gate: REPORT ONLY, no gate (GG decision, 2026-07-11): vscode's n=11 gives a [21,72]% CI on this proportion -- too underpowered to gate reliably. Surfaced here and in README for visibility instead. Unaffected by the continue-on-error promotion below -- this metric was never asserted on by any test, only reported.

prose_number_contradiction_rate.definition: fraction of plans where expected_resolution_summary's free-text time claim has ZERO overlap with [expected_resolution_lower_days, expected_resolution_upper_days] (src/triage_iq/models/resolution_consistency.py, ADR-0042, LEVER 4). Motivating case: k8s-14756 said 'typically 1 day or less' against a [2.8d, 21.6d] interval -- the model contradicting numbers it was directly given, not a hedging-tone issue.
prose_number_contradiction_rate.gate: BLOCKING (promoted 2026-08-10, same eval-gate.yml continue-on-error removal as fabrication_rate above): measured 0/64 on the current cassette.
